raw_definitions: Definisi : adj ; ~ silk , (kain) sutera siang malam; ~ through with st, diresapi sst: a system ~ through with graft and corruption, sistem yg diresapi sogokan dan rasuah; ~ with st, streaked, variegated, berselang-seli dgn sst: black hair ~ with grey, rambut hitam yg berselang-seli dgn uban. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
